title: Uniform Sharing of the AES S-box
summary: No uniform sharing of the AES S-box is currently known; the open task is to construct one suitable for bounded-query cryptanalysis while accounting for altered diffusion and the resulting need for more detailed security analysis.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether one can construct a uniform sharing of the AES S-box that is suitable for bounded-query cryptanalytic analysis of a masked cipher. No such uniform sharing is currently known, and directly applying the changing-of-the-guards method would alter the diffusion of the shared cipher and require a more detailed security analysis. The unresolved construction task is therefore to find a uniform sharing of the AES S-box while addressing this diffusion-related analysis requirement.

scope.domain: This concerns masked-cipher cryptanalysis and the design of uniform sharings for the AES S-box.
parameters: masked-cipher diffusion (property affected by the changing-of-the-guards method)
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a uniform sharing of the AES S-box suitable for bounded-query cryptanalytic analysis while addressing the diffusion change and the need for more detailed security analysis.

citations.label: Cryptanalysis of Masked Ciphers: A not so Random Idea

progress.summary: The source states that no uniform sharing of the AES S-box is currently known and highlights finding one as a future-work problem. It also notes that changing-of-the-guards would alter diffusion and require more detailed security analysis.
